description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigurationProvider class within the Aws\EndpointDiscovery namespace. It provides various static methods for creating configuration providers related to endpoint discovery, including default, environment-based, fallback, and ini file-based configurations, used in AWS SDK endpoint discovery mechanisms.

classes.name: ConfigurationProvider
classes.description: A static class providing various configuration provider methods for AWS endpoint discovery, including default, environment, fallback, and ini-file based providers.

methods.name: defaultProvider
methods.description: Creates a default configuration provider that checks environment variables, shared config files, and fallback options, optionally caching the result.

methods.name: env
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider that uses environment variables to determine endpoint discovery settings.

methods.name: fallback
methods.description: Provides fallback configuration options, potentially enabling endpoint discovery based on the API model.

methods.name: ini
methods.description: Creates a configuration provider using INI file settings, with support for custom profiles and filenames.

methods.name: unwrap
methods.description: Resolves a configuration provider into a ConfigurationInterface instance, handling callables, promises, and arrays.
